disclaimer: There is no published fixed menu. Regulars order at the counter; the board and daily specials change. Prices are not listed publicly — see the counter. Items below are compiled from Google, Foursquare tips, and published guides. Flagged items are frequently mentioned, not an official signature list.
note: Ask the counter for today’s specials.

sections.title: Sandwiches & Ciabatta
sections.intro: Made to order on ciabatta, focaccia or panini. Reviewers say there often isn’t a printed menu — point at the counter or ask.

items.name: Spicy salami, emmental & rocket
items.note: The most-named sandwich in public tips.

items.name: Spicy salami, mozzarella & rocket
items.note: A close cousin of the emmental version; also widely tipped.

items.name: Pastrami with mozzarella, rocket & tomato
items.note: Toasted ciabatta with pastrami also praised on Google.

items.name: Parma ham
items.note: Mentioned as a window special and in reviews.

items.name: Mozzarella veggie / vegetarian sandwich
items.note: Avocado, basil, tomato and cheese cited on Google. Veggie mozzarella ciabatta cited in guides.

items.name: Chicken escalope / schnitzel
items.note: Toasted chicken escalope sandwich; Tripadvisor guests mention a filling chicken schnitzel sandwich.

items.name: Roast chicken
items.note: Called “beyond words” in Foursquare tips.

items.name: Chicken, avocado, emmental & rocket ciabatta
items.note: Recommended as worth the lunchtime wait.

items.name: Mortadella
items.note: Salami and mortadella sandwiches described as “all top”.

items.name: Bresaola
items.note: Tipped as “wicked”.

sections.title: Hot / Pasta
sections.intro: Daily pasta specials rather than a fixed list. Friday lasagna is a recurring tip.

items.name: Daily pasta specials
items.note: Family-run lunch regulars mention changing pasta of the day.

items.name: Lasagna — Fridays
items.note: Foursquare: “Friday is lasagna day.” Also cited as lasagna in Google/Restaurant Guru summaries.

items.name: Toasted specials
items.note: Simone praised for toasted sandwiches on Google.

sections.title: Salads
sections.intro: Guides list salads alongside sandwiches and pasta. No public itemised salad board found.

items.name: Salads of the day
items.note: Mentioned in neighbourhood guides (Dessie, Restaurant Guru “salads”). Ask what is on.

sections.title: Breakfast
sections.intro: Open early on most listings. Pastries and breakfast sandwiches come up often.

items.name: Breakfast sandwiches
items.note: Guests plan return visits specifically for breakfast sandwiches.

items.name: Bacon & egg, Italian style
items.note: Foursquare tip on how they make a bacon and egg sandwich.

items.name: Chocolate croissants & Nutella muffins
items.note: Praised as “just like being in Italy”.

items.name: Pastries
items.note: Tasty pastries and coffee called exceptionally good value.
sources: Google — ollie mitchell via Restaurant Guru

sections.title: Coffee & Drinks
sections.intro: Italian coffee and bottled drinks. Historic tip prices are not current — ask the counter.

items.name: Espresso & coffee
items.note: Repeatedly praised; one 2014 tip mentioned espresso at £1.20 — treat as historical, not a live price.

items.name: Cappuccino / latte
items.note: Cappuccino and latte mentioned across Google and Restaurant Guru.

items.name: Chinotto
items.note: Italian bitter-sweet soda, called “wonderful” on Google.

sections.title: Sweet
sections.intro: Italian and bakery sweets mentioned in reviews — availability changes.

items.name: Cannoli
items.note: Loved alongside the coffee.

items.name: Pastel de nata
items.note: Paired with cappuccino after a Parma ham sandwich in a Google review.

items.name: Hazelnut mini-cannoli / cannelloni
items.note: A café-guide guest was too late for the popular hazelnut mini-cannoli; vanilla praised.
